note: Note a point of the draft. One call for each note.
score: The score for the whole text, to be called once at the end.
scoreReason: The reason for the score, in one line.
letter: The letter to the author about the whole text: call it once, at the end.
letterText: Two or three sentences: what works, the main problem, what is left to do.

grammar.citazione: The wrong words, copied exactly from the draft.

prose.citazione: The passage, copied exactly from the draft.
prose.problema: What doesn't work, in one sentence.
prose.proposta: Optional: how you would rewrite it.

structure.citazione: Optional: the passage you mean, copied exactly.
structure.osservazione: What doesn't add up, in one or two sentences.

facts.citazione: The claim, copied exactly from the draft.
facts.spiegazione: What the source says, in one line.
facts.correzione: Optional: the right value, if the source gives it.
